roham1_dataset.defect_analysis: Severe resolution confound: Non-flood images are 100% 224x224 fixed thumbnails of random non-road objects (indoor rooms, pets, objects); flood images are high-res mixed web photos.
roham1_dataset.suitability: REJECTED_DEFECTIVE (cannot be used for valid road flood benchmarking)

hyderabad_field_collection.provenance: Sahaay AI Phase 7/8 Field Pilot Protocol

task_distinctions.task_1_flooded_road_detection: Supported only with synthetic/confounded sources (Clemson vs Viren). NOT valid for production claims.
task_distinctions.task_2_wet_road_vs_inundated_discriminat: Viren potholes provide hard negatives, but positive counterpart is from distinct camera source.
task_distinctions.task_3_generic_flood_classification: Confounded; generic floods include aerial/indoor scenes outside road scope.
task_distinctions.task_4_image_quality_and_ood_rejection: Fully operational via ImageQualityGate and DecisionEngine abstention contracts.
